name: Carrot

schedule.notes: Surface-sow on fine seedbed. Keep evenly moist for 3 weeks — burlap helps.
To 2 in spacing. Crowded carrots fork.
Fall crop stores in the ground under mulch.
Pull when tops are pencil-thick at ground level.

harvest.cues: Shoulders are colored and 1 in across. Pull one to check. Smaller is sweeter.
harvest.storageNotes: Top, scrub, store in damp sand or in fridge in plastic bag. Months in cold storage.

varieties.name: Nantes
varieties.notes: Sweet, blunt-tipped, excellent eating. Reliable in clay.

varieties.name: Danvers 126
varieties.notes: Tapered, strong tops, tolerates heavy soils.

varieties.name: Paris Market
varieties.notes: Golf-ball round. Best for shallow beds and containers.

notes: Keep moist for the full 21-day germination — drying out is the #1 failure. Don't fertilize with fresh manure; you'll get hairy, forked roots.
